title: Require Service Proof Isolation
forbids: standalone service production source that imports, re-exports, dynamically imports, requires, or resolves a relative module source with an exact upward traversal before an exact test path segment
why: Package-root service proof may consume production behavior, but production source must not acquire proof fixtures, harnesses, or suites. Closed service topology owns valid production destinations while this source law keeps the dependency edge one-way.
remediate: Move proof-only code under the package-root test categories and remove the production-to-proof edge. Keep production operations, including an operation named test, inside the sealed production topology. Do not replace proof imports with an alias.
message: Standalone service production source must not import package proof code.
